lessons.title: 机场相遇
lessons.scene: Nora 刚抵达机场，找不到接机人，只好向路人询问去市区的路线。
lessons.sceneEn: Nora has just arrived at the airport and can't find her pickup, so she asks a passerby for directions to the city center.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.zh: 你好，请问去市区怎么走？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn qù shì qū zěn me zǒu?
dialogue.en: Hello, excuse me, how do I get to the city center?

dialogue.speaker: 明轩 · Mingxuan
dialogue.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu, yòu guǎi zuò dà bā.
dialogue.en: Walk straight ahead, turn right to take the bus.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。大巴到京华大学吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiè xie. Dà bā dào Jīng huá dà xué ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you. Does the bus go to Jinghua University?

dialogue.speaker: 明轩 · Mingxuan
dialogue.zh: 你是去京华大学的留学生吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shì qù Jīng huá dà xué de liú xué shēng ma?
dialogue.en: Are you an international student going to Jinghua University?

dialogue.speaker: 明轩 · Mingxuan
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ shì lái jiē nǐ de.
dialogue.en: Great! I'm here to pick you up.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Tài gǎn xiè le.

dialogue.speaker: 明轩 · Mingxuan
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Míng xuān. Xíng li gěi wǒ ba.
dialogue.en: I'm Mingxuan. Give me your luggage.

correct.note: 口语问路用【拐】不用【转】，更自然。
书面语，日常口语极少使用。
